name: ESPHome
short_description: Firmware builder and manager for ESP8266 and ESP32 devices.
description: ESPHome lets you program and manage ESP8266 and ESP32 microcontrollers using simple YAML configuration files. Flash custom firmware wirelessly, integrate sensors and actuators into Home Assistant, and monitor your devices — all without writing a single line of C++.
usecases: Create custom IoT sensors for temperature, humidity, and motion.
Build smart switches and plugs with ESP-based microcontrollers.
Wirelessly update firmware on dozens of ESP devices at once.
notes: ESPHome runs in host network mode to discover ESP devices on the local network.
First-time flash requires USB connection; subsequent updates are OTA.
